mainEntity.name: Who is eligible to enroll in the Healthcare & Medical Imaging Training programs?

acceptedAnswer.text: The programs are designed for medical imaging technologists, B.Sc/Diploma Radiography graduates, sonographers, radiology residents, and healthcare administrators looking to upgrade their clinical and technical competencies.

mainEntity.name: Are the training sessions conducted online or offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Victory Healthcare Services offers a flexible blended learning model comprising interactive online theory webinars and monthly live sessions, combined with bi-annual hands-on practical workshops on actual diagnostic workstations.

mainEntity.name: What imaging modalities are covered in the training curriculum?

acceptedAnswer.text: The curriculum covers Cross-Sectional Imaging, CT (Computed Tomography), MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging), Ultrasound/Sonography scanning, 3D Post-Processing workstations, and Radiology Department Administration.

mainEntity.name: Do participants receive a certificate upon course completion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, candidates who successfully complete the modular coursework, practical assessments, and attendance criteria receive a Certificate of Completion from Victory Healthcare Services Pvt Ltd.

mainEntity.name: How can I apply or enquire about course fees and upcoming batch schedules?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can enquire directly via the admission form on our Healthcare Training page, contact our admissions office at +91 99165 09090, or message us via WhatsApp.
